facts.fact: Mmegi reports BoFiNet relocated the Gaborone IXP to a more secure and resilient environment as part of a P100m gateway upgrade; no members or traffic are given, and as_of is the article date 2025-04-16 as no relocation date is stated.

note: The 100Gbps figure is international traffic, not exchange traffic; London and Johannesburg IXPs are outside BWA.
